name: Cittadella (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cittadella (a yellow castle on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Cittadella, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cittadella arms — yellow castle on red, crowned, within branches
